parsed.name: Timepix4 像素探测器
parsed.description: 用于实验中 Timepix4 像素探测器的控制与数据采集，可加载配置、设置像素阈值/掩膜/测试参数、管理以太网数据过滤，并启动、停止和记录探测数据。
parsed.description_en: Controls a Timepix4 pixel detector for laboratory data acquisition, including loading configuration, setting pixel threshold/mask/test parameters, managing Ethernet data filtering, and starting, stopping, and recording detector data.

actions.description: 按当前配置对 Timepix4 探测器执行配置。
actions.description_en: Apply the current configuration to the Timepix4 detector.

actions.description: 创建并设置探测器的数据采集对象或采集流程。
actions.description_en: Create and set up the detector acquisition object or acquisition pipeline.

actions.description: 选择用于管理探测器设置的配置类。
actions.description_en: Select the configuration class used to manage detector settings.

actions.description: 从配置类加载探测器配置和 DAC 设置。
actions.description_en: Load detector configuration and DAC settings from the selected configuration class.

actions.description: 初始化探测器可用的采集参数。
actions.description_en: Initialize valid acquisition parameters for the detector.

actions.description: 获取当前采集对象，以便直接调整采集参数。
